sentences.en: The president has adopted a hardline stance against abortion.

sentences.en: Yao Yilin and Song Ping, both hardline conservatives, were removed from the standing committee.

sentences.en: For many pro-reform Soviet citizens, Nevzorov personified the hardline editorial shift in television broadcasting.

sentences.en: The ruthless scenario was outlined by one hardline loyalist figure last week.

sentences.en: From it follows a series of hardline implications for the other practical issues.

sentences.en: The platform also takes hardline approaches to the issues of immigration and crime.

sentences.en: The older generation remembered how hardline colleagues had easily removed Khrushchev and brought the era of de-Stalinisation to an end in 1964.
